description: This header file defines metrics, metric sets, contexts, and related utilities for a logging/metrics framework within the ocudulog namespace. It includes enum definitions, template classes, macros for declaring metrics and metric sets, and container classes for managing metrics.

classes.name: metrics_container
classes.description: A wrapper class to access metrics and metric sets stored in a tuple, providing methods to read, write, and access elements.

classes.name: metric_list
classes.description: A list container for metrics of the same type, inheriting from the metric type.

classes.name: metric
classes.description: Represents a basic metric with a value, name, units, and kind.

classes.name: metric_set
classes.description: A group of metrics and/or metric sets sharing a logical relation, inheriting from metrics_container.

classes.name: context
classes.description: Represents a program context capturing the state via metric sets, with a name and metrics.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specific metric T within metrics_container.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the value of a specific metric T within metrics_container.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Accesses a metric or metric set of type T within metrics_container.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses an element at a specific index within a list-type metric, with assertions for bounds.

methods.name: contents
methods.description: Returns the raw tuple of metrics stored in metrics_container.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of a metric set or context.
